summary: Sega and RGG Studio's crime-drama action-adventure/RPG franchise, covering the Kiryu saga, Kiwami remakes, Japan-only historical and PSP spinoffs, Judgment branch, Ichiban RPG era, recent gaidens, and upcoming distant prequel.

entries.title: Yakuza

emulation.emulator: None for primary / PCSX2 for PS2 original
emulation.notes: Use native PC for Kiwami; PCSX2 only for original comparison.

primary.why: Yakuza Kiwami is the full remake of the first Yakuza with modernized presentation and added material; PC has the highest-fidelity official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Yakuza Kiwami on PC/Steam with current patches; use the PS2 original only for historical comparison.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original English dub/localization and PS2-era presentation.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the opening hours if the original localization/historical version matters.
secondary.why: Kiwami is the better full playthrough route, but the PS2 release is a distinct historical artifact.

entries.remaster_caveats: Kiwami changes presentation and some structure; preserve the PS2 version for original-release comparison.
